faq.question: HOW QUICKLY CAN A HIGH-VELOCITY SYSTEM BE DEPLOYED?
faq.answer: Standard architectural sprints span 3 to 6 weeks from initial technical blueprinting to global production rollout, including end-to-end stress testing and zero-downtime cutover.

faq.question: WHAT INFRASTRUCTURE AND STACKS DO YOU SPECIALIZE IN?
faq.answer: Primary core stack: Rust, Go, TypeScript, Next.js, WebGL/Three.js, Kubernetes, Kafka, Cloudflare Edge, and AWS/GCP bare-metal compute. We adapt to client infrastructure needs.

faq.question: DO YOU PROVIDE POST-LAUNCH PERFORMANCE AUDITING?
faq.answer: Yes. Every production delivery includes 90 days of continuous telemetry monitoring, latency profiling, and real-time incident diagnostics with dedicated SLA response guarantees.

faq.question: ARE CONTRACTS FIXED-PRICE OR TIME-AND-MATERIALS?
faq.answer: We primarily operate on fixed-deliverable milestone retainers to guarantee predictable outcomes and velocity, or embedded skunkworks leadership retainers for long-term engagements.
